phases.note: Hardened the two remaining false-compliance paths in Gate 8. (1) Check 1 (test suite): vitest 4.x removed the built-in json-summary reporter, so the gate's catch had been swallowing the missing report as SKIP — Gate 8 passed while the test-suite check was silently skipped. Rewritten to 'npx vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=<tmp>' (the supported replacement) with new fail-loud reader scripts/vitest-summary-reader.mjs (throws on missing file / bad JSON / missing fields / zero tests -> gate exit 1; a non-zero vitest exit is NOT fatal by itself since vitest still writes the JSON when tests merely fail). TAP fallback deleted. (2) Checks 3a/3b/3d (anyTypes / consoleCalls / bannedImports): were grep pipelines behind catch->PASS('N/A') — grep exits 1 on zero matches, which the catch swallowed as a false PASS, and local grep is ugrep while CI uses GNU grep (\b semantics differ). Rewritten in pure Node scripts/static-quality-checks.mjs (collectSourceFiles one fs walk of src/**/*.ts(x), symlinks skipped / countPatternLines line-based grep|wc -l semantics / countBannedImports per-literal sum); zero matches = legitimate 0, IO errors exit 1. Parity proof on the real tree: Node 117/45/0 = grep 117/45/0. Gate 8 now reports real numbers for all 8 checks (totalTests 7250, passRate 100%, no SKIP, no N/A). 21 new tests (9 reader incl. real end-to-end reporter run, 12 static incl. forced-error harness proofs). Fixed S14 harness-test regression: gate-harness source-rewrite now rewrites all three relative imports to absolute paths. CI gate-8 timeout 5 -> 15 min (check 1 + check 2 each run the full suite). Baseline thresholds unchanged; check 2 (coverage) untouched. Version 3.1.26 -> 3.1.27.
